name: webqsp
question_type: natural-language questions (from Google search queries) answered by entities of a Freebase knowledge graph, 1-2 relation hops from the topic entity
answer_format: exactly one answer: the name of one entity or value as it is written in the knowledge graph (e.g. a person's name, or a date written YYYY-MM-DD), no explanation; if several answers are correct, give any one of them
metric_description: Hits@1: exact match (SQuAD normalisation) of your single answer against any of the reference answers
meta: {"topic_entities": [<names of the question's topic entities, exactly as they appear in the knowledge graph>]}
corpus_note: The corpus is a **knowledge graph** (a Freebase subgraph): each document is one entity (`title`) and its `text` lists the entity's outgoing triples, one `head | relation | tail` per line. The same graph is in `corpus/triples.tsv` (`head<TAB>relation<TAB>tail`, {{N_TRIPLES}} triples). Entities named `m.…` or `g.…` are unnamed compound-value (CVT) nodes that link several facts.
